removal.deleteFiles: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} file(s)?
removal.deleteFilesInfo: You will be able to recover {{plural}} from your system's trash bin, but all assigned tags to {{plural}} in Allusion will be lost.
removal.searchItemRemovalInfo: Are you sure you want to delete the search item "{{name}}"?

importExport.overwriteInfo: Ini akan menimpa sebarang teg sedia ada (a.k.a. kata kunci) dalam fail tersebut dengan teg Allusion. Adalah disyorkan untuk mengimport semua teg sebelum menulis teg baharu.
